label: Consumer Prices of Liquid Fuels (includes VAT) by Month, Fuel and Information
note: The quarterly average price of renewable diesel will be released on 11 December 2025 retrospectively starting from early 2025. The quarterly average price data are based on data from the Tankille.fi service, which includes prices by service station and week. The fuel is based on separate sales of pure fuel and not blended fuel.

The current average price does not take weighting into account due to limited sales volume data. The average price will be released with the weighted price when the volume data of all the necessary companies are available.
